Logging._comment: The container image does not read this file (the API's content root there is /app, not /app/api), so the Dockerfile sets the same levels as Logging__LogLevel__* environment variables. Change both together. Microsoft.AspNetCore stays at Warning; the request log (HttpLoggingMiddleware) is the one line per request.

Normalization._comment: Casing policy for participant roles and environment names received via deploy ingest and promotion assign. Defaults to 'kebab-case' so inconsistent sender casings converge. Set to null to preserve sender casing as-sent.

Guides._comment: How-to walkthroughs the assistant can run for the user. Relative to the API's working directory, same as Catalog:Path. Override with the GUIDES_PATH env var.

Knowledge._comment: Reference topics the assistant answers from — webhooks, promotion policies, delivery tracks, service topology. Override with KNOWLEDGE_PATH.

Playbooks._comment: Authored failure causes the diagnostics match live evidence against. Override with PLAYBOOKS_PATH.
